murals.name: 七相之翼
murals.text: Scene: dawn on the south face of a vast snow ridge, looking up a long snow stair. Beside the stair, seven tall gates of pale rock stand one above another, framed by bands of coloured stone, red at the lowest, then orange, yellow, green, teal, blue and violet at the highest, each with a scale-shaped keystone, all glowing white. A straight bolt of red-gold lightning runs down the stair through every gate. In the foreground seven colossal winged, four-legged dragon skeletons, each as tall as a cliff, climb the stair away from us: pale stone-coloured bones, short straight horns, one of the seven colours glowing inside each ribcage, crumbling into drifting snow. Just below the centre, above the highest gate, one tall woman stands facing them, small in the frame: ivory hair to her waist, its tips lit in all seven colours, two short straight horns at her temples, a worn camel-brown travel coat, two huge membrane wings spread wide, banded in the seven colours. Up the slope behind her, among rows of blank standing stones, hundreds of tiny dragonkin kneel in the snow. Storm clouds over the crest tear open in straight rays of dawn.
murals.light: Main light: red-gold dawn breaking over the ridge crest behind her and the red lightning running down the stair, rimming her wings and turning the gates white; shadows in cold slate blue and violet.
murals.note: 选三幕第177-178行：天快亮，太阳落到她背上，她张开七相的元素翼，血里的赤红阳雷顺着雪阶贯穿七门，骸影在光里碎成雪。她在这一刻凝名（她的背景条第250行，迷宫纪·迷宫｜七重龙门和骸影第6405行）。镜头在雪阶下方往上看，骸影背对镜头，她面朝骸影，逆着天光。门的颜色和次序照第6396行，骸影的样子照第6398行。拿不准：她落在雪阶上时是人形还是龙形，源稿没写死（第171行从祭台飞起来的是一头龙，收束第184行写腰间七块鳞钥照亮了她收拢的翼），这里照人形加一对七色大翼写；头巾已交给尤恩，额角两截细角露着。碑林上的字不画，写成空白的立石。

murals.line: 深井的年月·第五十一层
murals.name: 万旗低垂
murals.text: Scene: a wide field of young green winter wheat under a flat grey pre-dawn sky that never brightens. A line of square boundary stones runs away across the field, each with one white face and one black face. Far behind, a long fortress wall with a fog-filled gate. Motionless grey phantom ranks fill both sides of the stones. In the middle distance crouches a colossus taller than the wall, heaped from the armour, shields and spears of the fallen with no bodies showing, its back bristling with flagpoles dense as wheat, arms of bundled spears, a bronze trumpet and a black horn twisted together like rope in its chest. In the foreground, just below centre, two small squads face each other across one stone, blades drawn, twelve in blue-grey, ten in black and red, a small banner sprouting from every back. Between them a tall man with tied-back dark red hair, two short horns angled back, a copper ring on the left horn and a plain grey cloak drives a broad longsword point-down at the stone's foot; thin lines on his neck and left arm glow pale gold. Every banner in the field, the colossus's too, hangs limp.
murals.light: Main light: flat grey pre-dawn light from an even overcast sky, plus the faint pale gold glow of the lines on his neck and arm; shadows in cool grey-blue.
murals.note: 选三幕第461-463行：两支兵在一块界碑两边刀对上刀，吉迪恩从界碑那一线上跑过来，把剑插进界碑脚下，说这里没有旗，那一层上的旗一面一面垂下来，他身上的纹从颈侧亮到掌心，他在这一阵走上圣座（第463行，凡世至强守井人第6840行）。那一层的样子照第440-441行和迷宫纪·迷宫｜第五十一层的楼层主第6429-6430行。它是拿两边的死人堆起来的，这里写成甲、盾、矛和旗堆成的大东西，写明不露尸首。旗只写垂着，不画纹样（佩雷格林背上那一面鹳旗略去）。两边的王旗、二十一个叫它收进去的人、门洞外攥绳的伯娜都没放进画面。

murals.name: 背守灰帘
murals.text: Scene: deep underground, a vast dark hall of stone pillars receding into blackness, thin water flowing one way across its floor. We look straight at the end of a narrow side passage, filled from wall to wall by a curtain of fine grey rain that falls from nowhere and never wets the ground, a soft grey veil; nothing shows through it. In front of the veil, in the centre and slightly low, two figures face toward us with their backs to the rain. A sturdy rabbit-eared guide sits on a stone right before it: thick snow-white braid, long ears tipped with grey, the left one folded in the middle, a grey short coat, a palm-sized wooden board with seven notches in her hand. Beside her stands a tall pale woman who has just stepped out of the rain: long silver-grey hair loosely knotted at the nape and beaded with tiny grey droplets, a dark red long coat hung from her left shoulder only, a black dress, a long black glove on her right arm. In the lower left foreground a small travelling oven glows; a fire-horned baker in a floury apron, white cloth round one short horn's root, holds out two loaves toward the woman, one white, one dark. A few figures sleep in blankets by the oven.
murals.light: Main light: the small warm glow of the baker's oven at the passage mouth, with a faint cold pallor from the rain curtain; shadows deep blue-black.
murals.note: 选一幕第735-736行：第七天天黑，帘子里没有人报名字，她自己从灰帘里走出来，头发上挂着灰的细水珠，在背着身坐着的妲西旁边站住，也背对着帘子，胡萨姆扒开炉子问她要白面的还是黑麦的。第四十七层的大厅、往一个方向流的薄水、岔道尽头的灰帘照第727-728行和迷宫纪·迷宫｜第四十七层的灰帘第6458-6459行。帘子那一边是什么只给 AI，画面里帘子不透东西。帘边墙上两列短竖刻痕没写，怕画成字或数字；七日牌这时还在妲西手里（第736行才钉到墙上），写成她手里一块刻了七道口的木牌。炉边裹着毯子睡的是前六天出来的第四探路队的人。巴尔缇娜的样子照这一页她的人物条第5574行。

murals.line: 深井的年月·第五十六层的路标
murals.name: 晶眼星图
murals.text: Scene: deep underground, a maze-like city street in motion: walls of interlocked white stone and black obsidian blocks, doorways under blank lintels, one wall sinking into the floor while another rises at the far end. On the open paving at the centre, around a single narrow crack where one small crystal burns white, spread rings of thin glowing lines and scattered bright dots like a star chart. Just below centre a tall, thin, stooped man kneels at the crack drawing a new ring with a glowing crystal pen: ash-grey hair held by two copper clips at the temples, a bandage over his left eye, a long dark grey cloak. Around the chart a single file of small soldiers winds in a loose ring, blue coats alternating with black-and-red armour, each gripping the belt of the one in front and watching that back, not the walls. Among them walk a tall fire-horned woman with an ember-tipped braid, copper horn-caps glowing red through vent holes and a black metal right arm, and two scribes hugging boards, one four-armed. To one side lies a bent bronze marker pole, its crystal lamp smashed, ringed with tooth marks like a gnawed bone.
murals.light: Main light: the white-hot crystal in the crack and the pale glowing star-chart lines on the floor, with small red glows from the horn-caps; shadows in cold slate blue and black.
murals.note: 选三幕第1117-1120行：沙希尔喊别看墙、看前头那个人的后背，八十三个人一个东边一个西边攥着腰带排成一排；奥尔文把左眼那只结晶义眼按进石缝，墙怎么换它不挪，他绕着它一回画一道线，地上一圈一圈亮线、一颗一颗亮点，两边的兵说像星。路标倒在一边、叫啃得像一根骨头是第1116行。门楣上原本刻着两边的字，写成空的门楣；路标杆身的字也不画，写成一根弯了的铜杆，不画横杆免得像十字。奥尔文这一段的凝名在最后进雾那一下（第1129行），这一幅没选那一下，选的是这一条最认得出的星图和攥着腰带的一排人。坎黛丝这时右臂还在（第1126行才留在缝里）。

murals.name: 接山之盾
murals.text: Scene: before dawn at a towering cliff under a broad rust-coloured waterfall. Behind the falling water a narrow wet walkway runs along the cliff from a dark mine mouth on the right to a stone ledge on the left, where a big bell hangs by a board of hooks with blank copper tags. Above, the upper cliff leans outward in huge slabs like a wall hanging from the sky, and the waterfall is bent aside. Small figures stream along the walkway toward the bell, miners pushing mine carts turned into stretchers. At the mine-mouth end, right of centre, a dwarf broad as a wall holds a grey-white tower shield taller than himself over his head against the first falling rocks, his knees sunk into the stone: grey-white short hair, a thick braided beard ending in a copper ring, dented scale armour. A crack of light runs from his feet down into the mountain. Behind him in the mine mouth, shell-backed segmented rock-borers crowd forward. A tiefling spearwoman with short pomegranate-red hair and a thin tail pushes the last cart past him; on the ledge a dwarf woman with rust-red braids coiled on her head hauls the bell rope.
murals.light: Main light: small warm lamps along the walkway and on the bell ledge in the pre-dawn dark, plus a pale grey glow on the shield rim and the crack of light at his feet; shadows deep slate blue.
murals.note: 选三幕第1452-1454行：整面崖往外倾，铁瀑的水先歪了，崖面一块一块像一堵从天上垂下来的墙朝栈道上压，栈道上还有一百来个人；麦格尼在矿口那一头把古龙骨粉塔盾举过头顶接住头一轮，双膝陷进岩里，那一股劲顺着身子走进地里，追出来的岩蛀挤在矿口里。他从这一天凝名断崖雷墙（第1492行）。推最后一辆车的是菲莱雅（第1450行），钟台上敲钟的是劳珂（第1451行老听壁叫她敲）。钩板上的铜牌写成空白的。地底下那一道雷写成从他脚下往山里走的一道亮缝，是我替画面想的样子。

murals.name: 七百根线
murals.text: Scene: night, inside a long storehouse lined with tall shelves of boxes. On the innermost shelf sits an open wooden box of thirty-odd deep blue shards like broken pieces of night sky, tiny points of light inside them; across the largest runs a long crack now closed by a dense seam of tiny stitches. Hundreds of fine glowing blue threads, just drawn back from the town, float through the room in loose loops and fill the dark rafters with blue light. Through the open door at the near end lies a narrow night street of tall old houses with every window lit. Just below centre, on the bare floorboards beside a single lamp, kneels a slender woman: pale lavender hair loosely pinned up with steel sewing needles, a grey-white smock with differently coloured patches on the sleeves, a string of thread spools at her waist, fingerless gloves. She draws the very last thread down to her own shadow on the floor and sets a needle into it; her shadow spreads far wider than the lamp could cast it, and the glow of the threads is sinking into it.
murals.light: Main light: the hundreds of glowing blue threads and the shard box, cool and bright, with warm lamplight from the windows beyond the door; shadows deep indigo.
murals.note: 选三幕第1719-1720行：第七夜最后一针，七百根线全收回封存库，她把最后一根线头牵到自己的影子上，说我听，你们睡吧，裂口合上，收回来的七百根线一起浮起蓝光照满梁柱，又随最后一针沉进她的影子。她在这一夜凝名（第1756行）。天幕碎片照第1686行，写成碎块，不画成圆的。门外那三条街家家亮灯借第1712行的样子。线头不剪（锁），画面里线头落在影子上。加斯帕那一刻在不在库里源稿没写，没放进去。

murals.name: 大阶长影
murals.text: Scene: evening on a windswept plateau of black stone. Seen from the side and below, a broad staircase of polished obsidian, thirty-three steps, rises from the lower left to the centre of the picture, where a stone platform stands before a severe dark courthouse; only a bright band of evening light remains along its roofline. On each step from the bottom up stands one small figure in fine noble clothes, thirty-two in all, most with heads bowed, and on each step's riser a pale sheet of paper is fixed with a single metal nail, no writing visible. On the top step stands a tall slender woman judge in a plain dark robe, straight black hair falling along her cheeks; small black wax seals are cracking and dropping away from her eyelids, her ears and the middle of her brow. A small halfling clerk with carrot-red curly hair and a grey coat stands at her side holding her hand. Her long shadow pours down the whole staircase over every nailed sheet to the plateau below, where a dense crowd watches, every figure reflected in the polished stone.
murals.light: Main light: low evening light from behind the courthouse roof, pale gold along the step edges; shadows deep blue-black on the obsidian.
murals.note: 选三幕第1993-1994行：坠叶月上旬一日傍晚，三十二个人一级站一个，三十二张判词一级钉一张，第三十二颗钉子敲进去，她眼皮、耳朵、眉心那五枚黑蜡一块一块裂了落下来，太阳落在法庭屋脊后头，她的影子从最上一级铺到最下一级，她在那一阵凝名法典之影。大阶三十三级、黑曜石照得出人影照迷宫纪·地点｜曜石审判庭第6589、6595行。判词写成白纸，不画字；判词上的山铜钉写成一颗金属钉。庞托牵着她站在身边照第1993行。

murals.line: 深井的年月·两边的名单
murals.name: 影落阶前
murals.text: Scene: first morning light in the oldest street of a great royal capital, tall pale stone mansions above and a broad white stone stair descending through them. At the foot of the steps of a columned law court, eighteen people in matching grey servants' livery sit close together on the lowest steps; standing before them, the nineteenth, a sturdy young woman with a thick straw-coloured braid and freckles, raises a hand as they call out in turn. Low early light slants into the street between the buildings at its far end. High on the court's pale side wall, a long violet-black shadow of a hooded woman is sliding down the wall and the steps, gathering into human shape at the feet of a slender hooded woman who stands at the edge of the group: long black-purple hair with ragged ends, two small black horns under the hood, fine dark violet lines on her neck, a frayed smoke-purple cloak, a ring of keys at her belt. The nineteen shadows lie beside hers in a row, stretching out into the sunlit street.
murals.light: Main light: low early light from the far end of the street, warm pale gold on the stone; long shadows in violet.
murals.note: 选三幕幕终第2313行：天亮头一声钟以后，她回到凯撒法庭的台阶底下，尤莉娅正领着十九个人报号，报到最后一个，日头照过来，高墙上的黑紫影子沿阶滑落，在她脚边收成人形，十九个人的影子挨着它排到日头照亮的街上，她在那一阵凝名。尤莉娅是十九个人里的一个，写成站在前头领着的那一个。报号写成举手，不画字和号码。凯撒本人不在画面里。金鸢城上城那一条白石大阶照第2312行。

murals.name: 回吐之光
murals.text: Scene: deep underground in a vast pitch-black hall whose walls sweat black. High under the ceiling a burst of gold-red light has just flared, lighting the walls and throwing long shadows across a floor littered with shed shell plates the size of pot lids. At the far end a colossal segmented creature, thicker than a tower, pale and soft, with no eyes and a ring of soft feelers around the mouth of its front segment, recoils backward into the dark, its soft hide split in places. In the centre foreground, three steps ahead of two raised tower shields, a tiny halfling woman stands with her feet planted: round flushed face, honey-coloured curly hair with a berry-red hairpin, a small cloak and apron, a ladle longer than herself at her belt. A big cooking pot with a glossy black bottom sits on the floor behind her. Behind the shields a dozen adventurers roped together stare up at the light, among them a lean barefoot young man with cropped dark blue hair and a night-wing priestess in white robes, a pair of large crow-dark wings on her back tied at the roots with a white sash.
murals.light: Main light: a sudden burst of gold-red light high under the ceiling washing the whole hall; deep violet-black shadows in the corners.
murals.note: 选三幕第2569-2571行：派派把老脾气放下，往盾前头走了三步，吞下它吐出来的那一口，打了个嗝，又吐了回去，它咽不下，身子一缩，软的那一层裂开几道口子往后退；那一口光在厅顶炸开，黑墙映成金红，十二个人七天里头一回看见彼此的脸。她把那一口吐回去的时候凝名（第2574行）。张嘴吞吐那一下不好画，写成她站在盾前头、光在头顶炸开。它的样子照迷宫纪·迷宫｜第四十四层的楼层主第6623行，地上的硬壳照第2557行。叶森这一年二十三岁，玛农是夜翼的白烛。

murals.line: 深井的年月·没有门框的门
murals.name: 咬手门
murals.text: Scene: deep in the well, a deserted city street under a dusk that never ends. Every door along it is shut and locked, a key hanging on a nail beside each; lamplit windows, bowls on tables, no one inside. At the street's end a black iron-bound side-hall door is just swinging open. In the middle of the street hangs a doorway-shaped opening with no frame and no door, showing a warm lamplit alley with one lit window at its end; the opening is breaking into thin glassy flakes that sweep past four figures. Just below centre, kneeling at its edge, a slender young man with ash-grey hair, a tiny copper padlock earring, a worn grey-brown leather coat and fingerless work gloves thrusts both hands into the outline where a frame should be, one fist clenched, as the edge closes on his wrists like a mouth. Half a step from the opening a sturdy young woman with an apricot braid and a white staff hung with a small bell stands frozen; behind her, a tall grey-green half-orc with an old iron-bound oak door on his back and a small-horned tiefling healer holding a candle lamp.
murals.light: Main light: warm amber lamplight inside the frameless doorway against the cold violet dusk of the street; shadows slate violet.
murals.note: 选三幕第2827-2828行：诺维安把那一把假钥匙攥在右拳里，两只手伸进那一块空该有门框的那一圈，数到三，那一圈像一张嘴合上来咬住他的手，钥匙在拳里碎了，侧殿的大门开了，假的铰链巷碎成透亮的薄片卷过四个人。他在罚落下来的那一刻凝名（第2865行，凝住的是名字，约810年才到传奇）。咬手那一下只写边缘合上来，不画伤和血。空底下石头上那一行字不画。等门的城的样子照迷宫纪·迷宫｜第四十九层的侧殿第6659-6660行（城里一直是傍晚）。琪娅的样子照人物百门之后那一队第6104行。

murals.line: 深井的年月·第七次楼层主讨伐
murals.name: 晾绳之门
murals.text: Scene: a vast hall of black stone deep underground, its ceiling lost in darkness. Against the far wall, beneath a crack high up from which a rope ladder hangs, stands a giant three storeys tall: dark bronze skin, eyes closed, two short horns jutting forward, a black tower shield planted at its feet with a huge handprint pressed into the iron, a spear as thick as a flagpole, small round seals riveted over its shoulders, arms and chest, a few of them glowing. Just below centre in the foreground, a tall slit of pale blue light has been torn open in the air along a taut white chalk line, wide as a door; through it lies a narrow night alley, laundry lines strung window to window, white bedsheets lifting in a gust, one warm lit window. A tall slim young woman with shoulder-length pale gold hair tied back with a string, a faded canvas travel coat and a copper chalk-line box at her waist pushes a huge black-scaled dragonkin with a tower shield through the opening; the wind from the alley blows her hair back, and a small seal on her chest glows with soft light.
murals.light: Main light: pale blue light from the torn doorway with a warm lit window beyond it, and a faint glow from the giant's seals; the hall in deep blue-black.
murals.note: 选三幕第3115-3116行：最后一个是肯特，她把他拖到门口，说上去，我在这儿，推了过去；他一过去，厅里起了一阵从门那一边吹过来的风，吹乱她的头发，她胸前那一枚旅印亮起圣歌的光，她凝名界门归还者（第3126行，凝住的是名字，约830年才到传奇）。门是她拿粉线弹开的（第3112行），门那一边是晾绳巷。楼层主这时站在西墙裂口底下（第3117行），样子照第3098行；盾面上錾着的十九不画数字，只画手印；角原写往前弯，写成短而前伸。灯底下躺着的人这时都已推过门，茹比那一盏灯跟没跟她过去源稿没写，这一幅没放灯。

murals.name: 钉潮
murals.text: Scene: night on the open sea under a low ceiling of black storm cloud. A wide ring of dead black water lies flat and glassy, and across it rises a narrow ridge of water marked by a white line where the sea parts both ways. A slim fast naval ship with fore-and-aft sails has ridden up onto the ridge, bow lifted; at its bow a tall broad-shouldered man with deep sea-blue hair tied back with rope, a short navy-blue coat and no armour, grips a long halberd with both hands, driven straight down into the ridge. Beside him a tall siren sings: pale coral hair streaming in translucent strands, a faint pearly sheen on her skin, thin gills behind her ears. Twelve battered ships with the same slim sails follow in a line, fishing boats among them with emptied holds, silver fish floating on the black water. Behind the whole line the sea is standing up into a sheer, flat-topped wall of water moving the same way, dark fins tossed in its face, the ships riding its forward slope. On a fishing boat a young woman with silver-grey scales on her neck and tousled copper hair blows a whistle.
murals.light: Main light: the soft pearly glow of the singing siren at the lead ship's bow and a few small ship lamps; everything else storm-dark navy and black.
murals.note: 选三幕第3438-3441行：渔船倒空了鱼排成一线跟着归针，归针骑上脊，亚历山大把船头那一杆长戟扎进潮汐的脊线压着不放，罗瑟琳在船头唱老调，往里收的黑水掉头往外翻，十三条船身后的水立成一道反着走的墙，十三条船骑在墙的前坡上。他在那一夜凝名海渊霸主（第3478行）。手掌裂开、血顺着戟杆流不画。海墙写成平顶直立的水墙，不写卷起的浪头，免得贴着天像弯月。帆写成纵帆，不画横桁，免得桅杆和横桁像十字。提娜在白鲭船头吹铜哨是第3441行后半夜的事，跟钉潮差一会儿，拿不准可以去掉。

murals.name: 九尾之晨
murals.text: Scene: first light of morning over rolling honey-coloured hill country dotted with low round-roofed hill houses. In a wide market square around an old well, a great bonfire stands unlit at the centre. Nine big heaps of paper bonds and ledgers stand in a ring around it, whole and unburnt, the last pale blue-white cold flames dying along nine faint streaks that run out of the square down nine roads. In the middle, just below centre, stands a petite fox-eared woman: waist-length golden-orange hair, a small notch in the tip of her left ear, a dark green short coat with cloth sleeve-guards, a ring of iron keys at her belt. Behind her fan out nine full golden-orange fox tails with white tips, all from one root where a single bronze bell hangs, the morning light shining through the fur. An old stooped halfling woman with a white hair bun and a blackened wax pot at her hip watches her back. At the far side of the square the first wagon of a returning caravan rolls in, its driver standing on the box and shouting, more wagons behind it, townsfolk gathered in a loose ring.
murals.light: Main light: low golden dawn light from beyond the eastern hills, glowing through her tails beside the fading blue-white cold fire; shadows soft slate violet.
murals.note: 选三幕幕终第3706-3707行：天亮的时候九堆票照旧是纸，她身后多了九条金橙的尾巴，尾根那一只铃照旧只有一只，晨光穿过尾巴，长辙家的车从九道还没散尽的冷火里滚进篝火广场，车夫喊幻月九尾。她在这一刻凝名（第3748行）。夜里那一团幻月是圆圆的一团、像天上多挂的一盏灯，怕画成月亮，这一幅不画它。丘陵上的风车有四片翼、怕像十字，没写；她腰上那只小算盘怕像东方的东西，也没写。尼诺这时在九岔驿，不在画面里；看着她背影的是丝缇（第3706行）。

notes: 派活时说这一页七条凝名短主线，实际是八条（七重龙门、断崖、七百个梦、两边的名单、七日的锅、没有门框的门、海墙、一枚金币，页头第3行和时段总纲第123行都是八位），八条都画了凝名的那一下。
带委托或没委托的五条主线里，第五十一层画的是吉迪恩插剑、旗全垂下、他走上圣座那一下，曜石审判和第七次楼层主讨伐画的是维多利亚、蕾雅凝名那一下，一段残响画的是第七天巴尔缇娜走出灰帘，第五十六层的路标画的是地上的星图和攥着腰带的一排人，没画奥尔文凝名进雾那一下，要换请主会话定。
七重龙门里阿蕾缇娅站在雪阶上是人形还是龙形，源稿没写死，这里照人形加一对七色的大翼写；要画龙形（苍白岩色的鳞，七色在角上和颈上流），请主会话改。
几位的角原写往后弯或往前弯（吉迪恩、胡萨姆、坎黛丝、菲莱雅、阿卡夏、第五十二层的楼层主、骸影），照派活说明一律写成短角；人都很小，角不贴着天。
怕像月亮、十字的东西都绕开了：一枚金币的幻月不画，天幕碎片写成碎块，各幅日出日落都写成太阳藏在山脊或屋顶后头，海墙写平顶的水墙，船写纵帆，风车没写，第五十六层的路标写成一根没有横杆的铜杆。
一段残响画了巴尔缇娜，两个王里的一位，派活说明没禁；七神、四执政、恶神这一页的画里都没有。
第五十一层那个楼层主是拿两边的死人堆起来的，写成甲、盾、矛、旗堆成的大东西，写明不露尸首，主会话看是否还要再收。
这一页暗场多（一段残响、第五十六层、七日的锅、没有门框的门、第七次楼层主讨伐都在深井里），暖光各只有一处，挂进拱廊以后会不会一圈都太暗，出图时看一眼。
十三个名字避开了全纪的主线名和任务名，跟别几页的壁画名撞不撞，要合起来再查一遍。
